title: chart-constrain
intention: STONE: the CONSTRAIN brick — stage 2 of the /chart chain, the first stackable learning brick built UNDER pre-installed judges (constrain-filters). One narrow question: 'what bounds this request?' — not what to build, not how (later stages). Three strata: FLOOR — deterministic: from the berthed orient packet (template-fill linkage: constrain's input IS the validated orient file), surface each ref'd component's charter falsifier/gates/owner VERBATIM (what exists; the constraints most often violated are exactly falsifiers, gates, ownership) — composed from chart's settled roster/ref machinery, never a parallel scan. TREE — the constrain brick's own corpus (nexus 'constrain', owner 'chart') through the generalized verbs, free since chart-tree. CEILING — the /chart stage-2 loop assembles: constraints[] (each text + source-that-resolves + kind), bounds {in, out} BOTH non-empty, unknowns, confidence, per-field provenance. The exit gate composes judge_constrain (the inspector's, imported): a packet failing its installed judges never berths — the door and the promotion gate are one implementation, two mouths. Deposit-back after berth: the bounds land as the tree's memory of this class of request.
why: The founding roster named constrain second, and the founding failure is constrain-shaped: the web-server carrier miss (CC-- 2026-07-28) was bounds-checking that never ran to completion — proximity to a plausible answer collapsed the bounds question into pattern-match. The stage exists to make the bounds an ARTIFACT (inspectable, diffable, gated) instead of invisible reasoning. Built under judges it did not write (Akien's higher-order build-the-test-first, this same ruling): the first berthed constrain packet must pass constraint_traces and constraint_bounds_complete, installed and PROVED before this ticket's BUILDME fired.
traces_to: Law 1 — a recurring class of request walks to its settled bounds instead of re-deriving them (deposit-back)
Law 3 — bounds as typed data with per-field provenance; an unknown is listed, never silently resolved
Law 4 — the exit gate composes the installed judges; template-fill from the orient berth makes stage-skipping a build error
Law 6 — constrain imports the inspector's judge, never the reverse; its tree is its own corpus through the one gate
Law 8 — the brick's first output passes a gate it did not write

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: cairn/machines/chart/proofs/test_chart_constrain.py under the tester's netns seal (schema gate refusals; floor surfaces charters verbatim, what-exists only; THE DOOR COMPOSES THE JUDGES — a packet the filters would red never berths; berth + deposit-back; AST allowlist). Live gate at PROVED: a real request charted through both stages — orient berth template-fills constrain, the packet passes the pre-installed judges, deposits back.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: the door passing what judge_constrain reds (the one-implementation claim); the floor deciding what APPLIES (it surfaces charter text verbatim; the ceiling decides); a constraint whose source the floor cannot resolve reaching the berth; bounds.out empty at berth (the founding failure recommitted); constrain.py imported BY the inspector (direction inversion); a parallel ref/roster scan instead of composing chart's settled machinery; stage 2 runnable without a berthed stage-1 packet (the template-fill physics bypassed).
falsifier.horizon: re-read when survey casts (stage 3 template-fills from constrain's berth — the handoff proves or breaks); when the constrain corpus has real deposits (/moreabout serves it unchanged — tenant-generic already); when a third constrain filter arrives through the brick's loop; when the dial reads constrain's first fractions (all-claude baseline expected).
